void emit(string text)
    println(text)

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

bool includes_text(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

bool contains_id(nat[] items, nat value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

string place_name(nat value)
    return if value == 0 then "D" else string(value)

string notation(nat[] path)
    return ["D"].concat([for item := path[] then string(item)]).append("D").join("-")

nat boundary(nat[] path, nat slot)
    return if slot == 0 or slot > #path then 0 else path[slot - 1]

int parse_minutes(string text)
    return int(text[:<2]) * 60 + int(text[3:])

string time_text(int minutes)
    hours := string(minutes / 60)
    return (if #hours == 1 then "0" else "") + hours + ":{minutes % 60:02.}"

string tenths(int value)
    return "{value / 10}.{value % 10}"

nat smallest_id(nat[] items)
    result := items[0]
    for item := items[]
        if item < result
            result = item
    return result

class Point(int x, int y)
class Stop(int x, int y, int demand, int service, opening := -1, closing := -1)
class Visit(nat id, int arrival, int waiting, int beginning, int leave, int late)
class Run(Visit[] visits, int finish, int travel, int waiting, int service, nat violations, int lateness)
class TourMove(nat first, nat last, int gain, nat size := 0)
class PlanMove(nat source, nat position, nat target, nat slot, int gain)
class Optimized(nat[] sequence, nat moves)
class TreeEdge(nat parent, nat child, int weight)
class Saving(nat first, nat second, int value)

class Workbench()
    depot_set := false
    depot := Point(0, 0)
    start_minutes := 480
    stop_table := map<nat, Stop>()
    tour_set := false
    nat[] tour := []
    plan_set := false
    nat[][] routes := []
    capacity := 0

    nat[] stop_ids()
        return stop_table.keys().sorted()

    Stop get_stop(nat id)
        match stop_table.get(id)
            Stop value
                return value
            none
                return Stop(0, 0, 0, 0)

    Point coordinates(nat id)
        if id == 0
            return depot
        Stop value := get_stop(id)
        return Point(value.x, value.y)

    int distance(nat first, nat second)
        Point a := coordinates(first)
        Point b := coordinates(second)
        return absolute(a.x - b.x) + absolute(a.y - b.y)

    int path_length(nat[] path)
        result := 0
        nat previous := 0
        for id := path[]
            result += distance(previous, id)
            previous = id
        return result + distance(previous, 0)

    int path_load(nat[] path)
        result := 0
        for id := path[]
            result += get_stop(id).demand
        return result

    int plan_length()
        result := 0
        for path := routes[]
            result += path_length(path)
        return result

    void .normalize()
        nat[][] result := []
        for path := routes[]
            if #path == 0
                continue
            if path[0] > path[-1]
                path = path[::-1]
            nat at := 0
            while at < #result and smallest_id(result[at]) < smallest_id(path)
                at += 1
            result = result[:<at].append(path).concat(result[at:])
        routes = result

    void | error require_depot()
        if not depot_set
            return error("no depot")
        return void

    void | error require_stops()
        if stop_table.size() == 0
            return error("no stops")
        return void

    void | error require_tour()
        if not tour_set
            return error("no tour")
        return void

    void | error require_plan()
        if not plan_set
            return error("no plan")
        return void

    void | error require_capacity(int q)
        for id := stop_ids()[]
            int demand := get_stop(id).demand
            if demand > q
                return error("stop {id} demand {demand} exceeds capacity {q}")
        return void

    void .install_tour(string label, nat[] path)
        tour = path
        tour_set = true
        emit("{label}: {notation(path)} length {path_length(path)}")

    void plan_report(string heading)
        emit("{heading}, routes {#routes}, length {plan_length()}")
        for: path := routes[r]
            emit("route {r + 1}: {notation(path)} load {path_load(path)} length {path_length(path)}")

    Run simulate(nat[] path)
        Visit[] visits := []
        timestamp := start_minutes
        nat previous := 0
        waiting := 0
        service := 0
        nat violations := 0
        lateness := 0
        for id := path[]
            Stop item := get_stop(id)
            int arrival := timestamp + distance(previous, id)
            wait := if item.opening > arrival then item.opening - arrival else 0
            late := if item.closing >= 0 and arrival > item.closing then arrival - item.closing else 0
            beginning := arrival + wait
            timestamp = beginning + item.service
            visits = visits.append(Visit(id, arrival, wait, beginning, timestamp, late))
            waiting += wait
            service += item.service
            if late > 0
                violations += 1
            lateness += late
            previous = id
        return Run(visits, timestamp + distance(previous, 0), path_length(path), waiting, service, violations, lateness)

    TourMove | none first_reversal(nat[] path)
        for: i < #path
            for: i + 1 <= j < #path
                int gain := distance(boundary(path, i), path[i]) + distance(path[j], boundary(path, j + 2)) - distance(boundary(path, i), path[j]) - distance(path[i], boundary(path, j + 2))
                if gain > 0
                    return TourMove(i, j, gain)
        return none

    Optimized two_opt(nat[] path, show_moves := true)
        nat moves := 0
        while true
            match first_reversal(path)
                TourMove change
                    if show_moves
                        emit("reverse {path[change.first]}..{path[change.last]} gain {change.gain}")
                    path = path[:<change.first].concat(path[change.first:<change.last + 1][::-1]).concat(path[change.last + 1:])
                    moves += 1
                none
                    break
        return Optimized(path, moves)

    TourMove | none first_segment(nat[] path)
        for: 1 <= nat size <= 3
            if size > #path
                continue
            for: i <= #path - size
                nat[] rest := path[:<i].concat(path[i + size:])
                first := path[i]
                last := path[i + size - 1]
                int removal := distance(boundary(path, i), first) + distance(last, boundary(path, i + size + 1)) - distance(boundary(path, i), boundary(path, i + size + 1))
                for: j <= #rest
                    if j == i
                        continue
                    int gain := removal - distance(boundary(rest, j), first) - distance(last, boundary(rest, j + 1)) + distance(boundary(rest, j), boundary(rest, j + 1))
                    if gain > 0
                        return TourMove(i, j, gain, size)
        return none

    TourMove | none first_swap(nat[] path)
        int before := path_length(path)
        for: i < #path
            for: i + 1 <= j < #path
                changed := path
                changed[i] = path[j]
                changed[j] = path[i]
                int gain := before - path_length(changed)
                if gain > 0
                    return TourMove(i, j, gain)
        return none

    nat[] exact_tour()
        nat[] ids := stop_ids()
        n := #ids
        powers := [for i := (0:<nat(n))[] then nat(2) ^ i]
        states := nat(2) ^ n
        full := states - 1
        int[][] costs := array(states, fill = array(n, fill = 0))
        for: i < n
            costs[0][i] = distance(ids[i], 0)
        for: 1 <= mask < full
            for: i < n
                if mask / powers[i] % 2 == 1
                    continue
                set_cost := false
                best := 0
                for: j < n
                    if mask / powers[j] % 2 == 1
                        int value := distance(ids[i], ids[j]) + costs[mask - powers[j]][j]
                        if not set_cost or value < best
                            best = value
                            set_cost = true
                costs[mask][i] = best
        cost := 0
        cost_set := false
        for: i < n
            int value := distance(0, ids[i]) + costs[full - powers[i]][i]
            if not cost_set or value < cost
                cost = value
                cost_set = true
        nat[] path := []
        nat current := 0
        mask := full
        while mask > 0
            for: i < n
                if mask / powers[i] % 2 == 1 and distance(current, ids[i]) + costs[mask - powers[i]][i] == cost
                    mask -= powers[i]
                    cost = costs[mask][i]
                    current = ids[i]
                    path = path.append(current)
                    break
        return path

    TreeEdge[] spanning_tree(nat[] vertices)
        tree := vertices[:<1]
        remaining := vertices[1:]
        TreeEdge[] edges := []
        while #remaining != 0
            best := TreeEdge(0, 0, 0)
            best_set := false
            for child := remaining[]
                for parent := tree[]
                    int weight := distance(parent, child)
                    if not best_set or weight < best.weight
                        best = TreeEdge(parent, child, weight)
                        best_set = true
            edges = edges.append(best)
            tree = tree.append(best.child)
            remaining = [for id := remaining[] if id != best.child then id]
        return edges

    bool sweep_less(nat first, nat second)
        Point a := coordinates(first)
        Point b := coordinates(second)
        int x := a.x - depot.x
        int y := a.y - depot.y
        int u := b.x - depot.x
        int v := b.y - depot.y
        az := x == 0 and y == 0
        bz := u == 0 and v == 0
        if az != bz
            return az
        if az
            return first < second
        ah := y > 0 or (y == 0 and x > 0)
        bh := v > 0 or (v == 0 and u > 0)
        if ah != bh
            return ah
        cross := x * v - y * u
        if cross != 0
            return cross > 0
        da := absolute(x) + absolute(y)
        db := absolute(u) + absolute(v)
        return if da != db then da < db else first < second

    nat[] sweep_order()
        nat[] result := []
        for id := stop_ids()[]
            nat at := 0
            while at < #result and not sweep_less(id, result[at])
                at += 1
            result = result[:<at].append(id).concat(result[at:])
        return result

    void | error .savings(int q, int limit)
        nat[] ids := stop_ids()
        if limit >= 0
            for id := ids[]
                if 2 * distance(0, id) > limit
                    return error("stop {id} too far for limit {limit}")
        Saving[] pairs := []
        for: first := ids[i]
            for second := ids[i + 1:][]
                int value := distance(0, first) + distance(0, second) - distance(first, second)
                if value > 0
                    nat at := 0
                    while at < #pairs and pairs[at].value >= value
                        at += 1
                    pairs = pairs[:<at].append(Saving(first, second, value)).concat(pairs[at:])
        nat[][] paths := [for id := ids[] then [id]]
        nat merges := 0
        for pair := pairs[]
            nat r := 0
            nat t := 0
            for: path := paths[i]
                if contains_id(path, pair.first)
                    r = i
                if contains_id(path, pair.second)
                    t = i
            if r == t
                continue
            a := paths[r]
            b := paths[t]
            if not (pair.first == a[0] or pair.first == a[-1]) or not (pair.second == b[0] or pair.second == b[-1])
                continue
            if path_load(a) + path_load(b) > q
                continue
            if a[0] == pair.first
                a = a[::-1]
            if b[-1] == pair.second
                b = b[::-1]
            nat[] merged := a.concat(b)
            if limit >= 0 and path_length(merged) > limit
                continue
            paths = [for i := paths.indices()[] if i != r and i != t then paths[i]].append(merged)
            merges += 1
        capacity = q
        routes = paths
        plan_set = true
        .normalize()
        plan_report("vrp: capacity {q}, merges {merges}")
        return void

    void .split_plan(int q)
        n := #tour
        best := array(n + 1, fill = 0)
        nat[] previous := array(n + 1, fill = 0)
        for: 1 <= j <= n
            found := false
            for: i < j
                segment := tour[i:<j]
                if path_load(segment) > q
                    continue
                int value := best[i] + path_length(segment)
                if not found or value < best[j]
                    found = true
                    best[j] = value
                    previous[j] = i
        nat[][] paths := []
        at := n
        while at > 0
            paths = paths.append(tour[previous[at]:<at])
            at = previous[at]
        capacity = q
        routes = paths
        plan_set = true
        .normalize()
        plan_report("split: capacity {q}")

    PlanMove | none first_relocation()
        for: source := routes[r]
            for: id := source[p]
                int removal := distance(boundary(source, p), id) + distance(id, boundary(source, p + 2)) - distance(boundary(source, p), boundary(source, p + 2))
                for: target := routes[t]
                    if t == r or path_load(target) + get_stop(id).demand > capacity
                        continue
                    for: j <= #target
                        int gain := removal - distance(boundary(target, j), id) - distance(id, boundary(target, j + 1)) + distance(boundary(target, j), boundary(target, j + 1))
                        if gain > 0
                            return PlanMove(r, p, t, j, gain)
        return none

    PlanMove | none first_exchange()
        for: a := routes[r]
            for: r + 1 <= t < #routes
                b := routes[t]
                int total := path_length(a) + path_length(b)
                for: id := a[p]
                    for: other := b[j]
                        int shift := get_stop(other).demand - get_stop(id).demand
                        if path_load(a) + shift > capacity or path_load(b) - shift > capacity
                            continue
                        first := a
                        second := b
                        first[p] = other
                        second[j] = id
                        int gain := total - path_length(first) - path_length(second)
                        if gain > 0
                            return PlanMove(r, p, t, j, gain)
        return none

    PlanMove | none first_cross()
        for: a := routes[r]
            for: r + 1 <= t < #routes
                b := routes[t]
                for: i <= #a
                    for: j <= #b
                        if path_load(a[:<i].concat(b[j:])) > capacity or path_load(b[:<j].concat(a[i:])) > capacity
                            continue
                        int gain := distance(boundary(a, i), boundary(a, i + 1)) + distance(boundary(b, j), boundary(b, j + 1)) - distance(boundary(a, i), boundary(b, j + 1)) - distance(boundary(b, j), boundary(a, i + 1))
                        if gain > 0
                            return PlanMove(r, i, t, j, gain)
        return none

    void .improve_plan(string kind)
        int before := plan_length()
        count_before := #routes
        nat moves := 0
        while true
            PlanMove | none candidate := if kind == "RELOCATE" then first_relocation() else (if kind == "EXCHANGE" then first_exchange() else first_cross())
            match candidate
                PlanMove change
                    r := change.source
                    p := change.position
                    t := change.target
                    j := change.slot
                    a := routes[r]
                    b := routes[t]
                    if kind == "RELOCATE"
                        id := a[p]
                        emit("relocate {id} from route {r + 1} to route {t + 1} after {place_name(boundary(b, j))} gain {change.gain}")
                        routes[r] = a[:<p].concat(a[p + 1:])
                        routes[t] = b[:<j].append(id).concat(b[j:])
                    elif kind == "EXCHANGE"
                        emit("exchange {a[p]} (route {r + 1}) with {b[j]} (route {t + 1}) gain {change.gain}")
                        routes[r][p] = b[j]
                        routes[t][j] = a[p]
                    else
                        emit("cross route {r + 1} after {place_name(boundary(a, p))} with route {t + 1} after {place_name(boundary(b, j))} gain {change.gain}")
                        routes[r] = a[:<p].concat(b[j:])
                        routes[t] = b[:<j].concat(a[p:])
                    .normalize()
                    moves += 1
                none
                    break
        heading := if kind == "RELOCATE" then "relocate" else (if kind == "EXCHANGE" then "exchange" else "cross")
        counts := if kind == "EXCHANGE" then "" else "routes {count_before} -> {#routes}, "
        emit("{heading}: moves {moves}, {counts}length {before} -> {plan_length()}")

    void | error .execute(string line)
        parts := line.split(" ")
        command := parts[0]
        args := parts[1:]
        if command == "DEPOT"
            depot = Point(int(args[0]), int(args[1]))
            depot_set = true
            emit("depot at ({depot.x},{depot.y})")
        elif command == "START"
            start_minutes = parse_minutes(args[0])
            emit("start {time_text(start_minutes)}")
        elif command == "STOP"
            id := nat(args[0])
            if stop_table.has(id)
                return error("stop {id} already exists")
            opening := -1
            closing := -1
            if #args == 7
                opening = parse_minutes(args[5])
                closing = parse_minutes(args[6])
                if opening > closing
                    return error("invalid window")
            .stop_table.set(id, Stop(int(args[1]), int(args[2]), int(args[3]), int(args[4]), opening, closing))
            tour_set = false
            plan_set = false
            emit("stop {id} added")
        elif command == "REMOVE"
            id := nat(args[0])
            if not stop_table.has(id)
                return error("unknown stop {id}")
            bool removed := .stop_table.remove(id)
            if tour_set
                tour = [for item := tour[] if item != id then item]
            if plan_set
                routes = [for path := routes[] then [for item := path[] if item != id then item]]
                .normalize()
            if stop_table.size() == 0
                tour_set = false
                plan_set = false
            emit("stop {id} removed")
        elif command == "LIST"
            emit(if depot_set then "depot ({depot.x},{depot.y})" else "depot none")
            emit("start {time_text(start_minutes)}")
            emit("stops {stop_table.size()}")
            for id := stop_ids()[]
                Stop item := get_stop(id)
                window := if item.opening < 0 then "none" else "{time_text(item.opening)}-{time_text(item.closing)}"
                emit("{id} at ({item.x},{item.y}) demand {item.demand} service {item.service} window {window}")
        elif command == "MATRIX"
            try require_depot()
            nat[] ids := [nat(0)].concat(stop_ids())
            string[][] table := [[""].concat([for id := ids[] then place_name(id)])]
            for id := ids[]
                table = table.append([place_name(id)].concat([for other := ids[] then string(distance(id, other))]))
            nat width := 0
            for row := table[]
                for cell := row[]
                    if #cell > width
                        width = #cell
            for row := table[]
                emit([for cell := row[] then " " * (width - #cell) + cell].join(" "))
        elif includes_text(["ORDER", "NEAREST", "INSERTION", "EXACT", "BOUND", "VRP", "SWEEP"], command)
            try require_depot()
            try require_stops()
            nat[] ids := stop_ids()
            if command == "ORDER"
                nat[] path := [for arg := args[] then nat(arg)]
                for id := path[]
                    if not stop_table.has(id)
                        return error("unknown stop {id}")
                nat[] seen := []
                for id := path[]
                    if contains_id(seen, id)
                        return error("duplicate stop {id}")
                    seen = seen.append(id)
                if #path != #ids
                    return error("order has {#path} stops, expected {#ids}")
                .install_tour("order", path)
            elif command == "NEAREST"
                remaining := ids
                nat[] path := []
                nat current := 0
                while #remaining != 0
                    chosen := remaining[0]
                    for id := remaining[]
                        if distance(current, id) < distance(current, chosen)
                            chosen = id
                    path = path.append(chosen)
                    remaining = [for id := remaining[] if id != chosen then id]
                    current = chosen
                .install_tour("nearest", path)
            elif command == "INSERTION"
                remaining := ids
                nat[] path := []
                while #remaining != 0
                    best_set := false
                    best := 0
                    nat chosen := 0
                    nat slot := 0
                    for id := remaining[]
                        for: j <= #path
                            int value := distance(boundary(path, j), id) + distance(id, boundary(path, j + 1)) - distance(boundary(path, j), boundary(path, j + 1))
                            if not best_set or value < best
                                best = value
                                best_set = true
                                chosen = id
                                slot = j
                    path = path[:<slot].append(chosen).concat(path[slot:])
                    remaining = [for id := remaining[] if id != chosen then id]
                .install_tour("insertion", path)
            elif command == "EXACT"
                if #ids > 10
                    return error("too many stops for exact ({#ids})")
                .install_tour("exact", exact_tour())
            elif command == "BOUND"
                TreeEdge[] edges := spanning_tree([nat(0)].concat(ids))
                mst := 0
                for edge := edges[]
                    mst += edge.weight
                emit("mst: " + [for edge := edges[] then "{place_name(edge.parent)}-{edge.child}"].join(" ") + " (length {mst})")
                int[] distances := [for id := ids[] then distance(0, id)].sorted()
                one := 2 * distances[0]
                if #ids > 1
                    one = distances[0] + distances[1]
                    for edge := spanning_tree(ids)[]
                        one += edge.weight
                best := if mst > one then mst else one
                emit("bound: mst {mst}, one-tree {one}, best {best}")
                if not tour_set
                    emit("gap: no tour")
                else
                    int total := path_length(tour)
                    gap := if best == 0 then 0 else (2000 * (total - best) + best) / (2 * best)
                    emit("gap: tour {total}, {tenths(gap)}%")
            else
                q := int(args[0])
                try require_capacity(q)
                if command == "VRP"
                    try .savings(q, if #args == 2 then int(args[1]) else -1)
                else
                    nat[][] paths := []
                    nat[] current := []
                    used := 0
                    for id := sweep_order()[]
                        int demand := get_stop(id).demand
                        if used + demand > q
                            paths = paths.append(current)
                            current = []
                            used = 0
                        current = current.append(id)
                        used += demand
                    paths = paths.append(current)
                    capacity = q
                    routes = paths
                    plan_set = true
                    .normalize()
                    plan_report("sweep: capacity {q}")
        elif command == "TOUR"
            try require_tour()
            emit("tour: {notation(tour)} length {path_length(tour)}")
        elif command == "TWOOPT" or command == "OROPT" or command == "SWAP"
            try require_tour()
            int before := path_length(tour)
            nat moves := 0
            if command == "TWOOPT"
                Optimized result := two_opt(tour)
                tour = result.sequence
                moves = result.moves
            else
                while true
                    TourMove | none candidate := if command == "OROPT" then first_segment(tour) else first_swap(tour)
                    match candidate
                        TourMove change
                            i := change.first
                            j := change.last
                            if command == "OROPT"
                                segment := tour[i:<i + change.size]
                                nat[] rest := tour[:<i].concat(tour[i + change.size:])
                                listing := [for id := segment[] then string(id)].join("-")
                                emit("move {listing} after {place_name(boundary(rest, j))} gain {change.gain}")
                                tour = rest[:<j].concat(segment).concat(rest[j:])
                            else
                                emit("swap {tour[i]} and {tour[j]} gain {change.gain}")
                                first := tour[i]
                                tour[i] = tour[j]
                                tour[j] = first
                            moves += 1
                        none
                            break
            heading := if command == "TWOOPT" then "twoopt" else (if command == "OROPT" then "oropt" else "swap")
            emit("{heading}: moves {moves}, length {before} -> {path_length(tour)}")
        elif command == "TIMECHECK"
            nat[] path := []
            if #args == 0
                try require_tour()
                path = tour
                emit("timecheck tour depart {time_text(start_minutes)}")
            else
                try require_plan()
                r := nat(args[0])
                if r > #routes
                    return error("no route {r}")
                path = routes[r - 1]
                emit("timecheck route {r} depart {time_text(start_minutes)}")
            Run result := simulate(path)
            for visit := result.visits[]
                status := if visit.late > 0 then "late {visit.late}" else "ok"
                emit("{visit.id} arrive {time_text(visit.arrival)} wait {visit.waiting} begin {time_text(visit.beginning)} leave {time_text(visit.leave)} {status}")
            emit("return {time_text(result.finish)}, travel {result.travel}, wait {result.waiting}, service {result.service}, violations {result.violations}, lateness {result.lateness}")
        elif command == "SPLIT"
            try require_tour()
            q := int(args[0])
            try require_capacity(q)
            .split_plan(q)
        elif command == "ROUTES"
            try require_plan()
            plan_report("plan: capacity {capacity}")
        elif command == "RELOCATE" or command == "EXCHANGE" or command == "CROSS"
            try require_plan()
            .improve_plan(command)
        elif command == "ROUTEOPT"
            try require_plan()
            int before := plan_length()
            for: path := routes[r]
                int old := path_length(path)
                Optimized result := two_opt(path, false)
                routes[r] = result.sequence
                emit("route {r + 1}: moves {result.moves}, length {old} -> {path_length(result.sequence)}")
            .normalize()
            emit("routeopt: length {before} -> {plan_length()}")
        elif command == "REPORT"
            demand := 0
            service := 0
            nat windows := 0
            for id := stop_ids()[]
                Stop item := get_stop(id)
                demand += item.demand
                service += item.service
                if item.opening >= 0
                    windows += 1
            emit("report: stops {stop_table.size()}, demand {demand}, service {service}, windows {windows}")
            if not tour_set
                emit("tour: none")
            else
                Run result := simulate(tour)
                emit("tour: length {result.travel}, return {time_text(result.finish)}, violations {result.violations}, lateness {result.lateness}")
            if not plan_set
                emit("plan: none")
            else
                total := 0
                latest := 0
                nat violations := 0
                lateness := 0
                for path := routes[]
                    total += path_load(path)
                    Run result := simulate(path)
                    if result.finish > latest
                        latest = result.finish
                    violations += result.violations
                    lateness += result.lateness
                k := int(#routes)
                utilization := (2000 * total + k * capacity) / (2 * k * capacity)
                emit("plan: capacity {capacity}, routes {#routes}, length {plan_length()}, utilization {tenths(utilization)}%, return {time_text(latest)}, violations {violations}, lateness {lateness}")
        return void
